Selected documented conversion, not a fabricated dedicated Tekken 3 cabinet. The visible side is plain gray; no Jin poster or unseen side print is inferred.
Marquee, brown deck and Tekken 3 screen are rectified from the same chosen cabinet. The separate lightning overlay is research only. Instruction scan supplies two narrow bezel strips.

Photographed real game screen, not a local emulation capture: perspective is rectified, aspect preserved and brightness increased 1.5x for tiny sprite visibility. Reflections and photo detail remain limited.

Two ball-top sticks, four physical actions per station follow this conversion: left blue/red punches, right red punches, yellow kicks. White Start buttons remain photographed, not additional raised actions.
Shared stepped upright geometry is a low-resolution approximation of the gray shell; side/gray front colors and coin door are modeled. ROM/core/player count and map remain unchanged.
